```{asis, echo = {{bayes_anohe_knit}}, eval = {{bayes_anohe_knit}}, include = {{bayes_anohe_knit}}}
### Produce tables of hetereogeneity statistics

Three models are required to generate the heterogeneity statistics, therefore expect it to take three times as long to run as the NMA model.

```

```{r, echo = {{bayes_anohe_knit}}, include = {{bayes_anohe_knit}}}
knitr::kable(bayes_anohe(bayes_model_all), 
             caption = "Treatment effects for all studies: comparison of all treatment pairs.")
```

```{r, echo = {{bayes_anohe_knit}}, include = {{bayes_anohe_knit}}}
knitr::kable(bayes_anohe(bayes_model_sub), 
             caption = "Treatment effects with selected studies excluded: comparison of all treatment pairs.")
```
